title: Unplanned outage at Kollsnes processing plant cuts 18 mcm/day, Gassco confirms
snippet: Norwegian gas system operator Gassco said an unplanned outage at the Kollsnes processing plant has reduced capacity by 18 mcm per day with an uncertain end time. Flows to Easington were affected.

title: Norway's Kollsnes plant hit by unplanned outage, gas prices rise
snippet: European gas prices rose after an unplanned outage at Norway's Kollsnes plant reduced supply by 18 mcm/day.

title: Kollsnes outage: Norwegian supply down 18 mcm/day
snippet: An unplanned outage has cut Norwegian gas supply. Traders reported an immediate reaction at NBP and TTF.

title: Unavailability: PALUEL 2 (1330 MW)
snippet: 10YFR-RTE------C A80 stress corrosion inspection extended from 2026-07-23 to 2026-09-14. French nuclear reactor offline.

title: GB REMIT: Heysham 2 unavailable 610 MW
snippet: Unplanned technical fault, active. Nuclear reactor offline from 2026-07-23T06:14:00Z to 2026-07-29T00:00:00Z.

title: Tanker attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, shipping insurers raise war risk premiums
snippet: A vessel was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz overnight. Escalation fears lifted crude by 4% and freight rates jumped. Naval escort arrangements are under discussion.

title: EU gas storage: unusual withdrawal, now 62.4% full
snippet: Net withdrawal of 0.41 against a 14-day average of 0.18. Storage at 62.4 per cent full on 2026-07-22, below the five-year average for the date.

title: Ofgem opens consultation on network charging methodology reform
snippet: Ofgem has launched a consultation on changes to the network charges methodology, with a code modification expected to enter into force in April 2027.

title: Freeport LNG train 2 halted by compressor failure, feedgas drops 30%
snippet: A compressor failure has halted liquefaction train 2. Feedgas nominations fell by roughly 30 per cent. Cargo loading suspended at the jetty.

title: European Commission proposes revision of gas storage filling targets
snippet: The European Commission has proposed changes to the storage obligation, softening the filling target ahead of the injection season. The draft law goes to a vote in September.

title: Prolonged heatwave forecast across southern Europe, cooling demand to surge
snippet: Weather models point to extreme heat across Spain, Italy and France for the next fortnight, well above seasonal norms. Cooling demand is expected to lift power burn.

title: Sanctions package targets shadow fleet vessels carrying crude
snippet: A new sanctions package names 40 shadow fleet tankers. Analysts expect limited immediate impact on flows but a wider chilling effect on freight.

title: Interconnector cable fault cuts capacity between GB and Belgium
snippet: A cable fault has reduced interconnector capacity by 500 MW. National Grid confirmed repairs are under way with return to service uncertain.

title: Analyst says European gas could rally if winter proves colder than expected
snippet: A bank analyst suggested prices may rise and could test new highs, though the outlook for demand remains uncertain and much depends on weather.

title: Company explores potential final investment decision on new LNG project
snippet: The developer is considering options and may take a final investment decision next year. It aims to reach first gas by 2031.

title: Top 10 energy stocks to buy now for massive gains
snippet: Our price prediction says these penny stocks could make you a millionaire this year.

title: New energy drink launches across UK supermarkets
snippet: The energy drink brand is expanding distribution nationwide.

title: Premier League transfer window closes with record spending
snippet: Clubs spent a record amount in the transfer window.

title: Dunkelflaute conditions forecast for northern Europe next week
snippet: Low wind and still conditions are forecast across Germany and the Netherlands, with wind output expected to fall sharply. Tight margins possible.

title: EUA prices climb as market stability reserve adjustment confirmed
snippet: Carbon allowances rose after the market stability reserve adjustment was confirmed, tightening supply into the next compliance deadline.

title: Bacton terminal maintenance extended by four days
snippet: Planned maintenance at the Bacton entry point has been extended, reducing UK entry capacity by 12 mcm/day until Friday.

title: OPEC+ agrees production quota rollover for the fourth quarter
snippet: OPEC+ confirmed a rollover of existing output cuts, leaving spare capacity broadly unchanged. Brent traded a dollar higher.

title: Reactor restart delayed at Belgian nuclear plant after weld inspection
snippet: The restart has been delayed by three weeks following a weld inspection. 1040 MW remains offline.

title: Subsea cable damage reported in the Baltic, investigation under way
snippet: Authorities are investigating damage to a subsea cable. Sabotage has not been ruled out. Critical infrastructure protection measures have been stepped up.

title: World Nuclear News: lifetime extension approved for two reactors
snippet: Regulatory approval has been granted for a life extension covering two reactors, adding 1800 MW of firm capacity through to 2045.

title: Kollsnes outage to last into Wednesday, Gassco says
snippet: Gassco extended its estimate for the unplanned Kollsnes outage. Capacity remains reduced by 18 mcm/day.

title: Kollsnes returns to full capacity after unplanned outage
snippet: Gassco confirmed Kollsnes is back at full capacity. Norwegian flows to Easington have normalised.
